subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of privileged GitHub Action revisions after the four guard assertions are repaired?
rationale: Mechanical checks can prove local pin consistency, but accepting new third-party executable code that receives tokens, secrets, publishing permissions, security results, or agent credentials is an owner security decision.

options.title: Audit and accept batch
options.body: Review the privileged upstream revisions together, repair the guards, and merge after refreshed exact-head checks.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL/SARIF, maintenance, and Codex Action updates into smaller independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Hold existing pins
options.body: Retain the current revisions until owners are ready to complete the supply-chain audit.

recommendation.title: Audit and accept batch
recommendation.body: Review the privileged upstream revisions together, repair the guards, and merge after refreshed exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available individual routing candidate adjacent to the security-owned workflow and guard surface.
